hero.headline: Capture it. Find it. Put it to work.
hero.lede: Keep text and images in a privacy-first local archive, organize what matters into custom collections, bring clips back instantly through Quick Paste, and inspect their activity ledgers.

card.tagline: Capture it. Find it. Put it to work.
card.summary: Keep text and images in a privacy-first local archive, organize what matters into custom collections, bring clips back instantly through Quick Paste, and inspect their activity ledgers.

sections.title: Local clipboard workspace for Windows & mobile.
sections.lede: Capture, organize, retrieve, act, inspect history, and export—all on your own machine.

items.title: Multi-Format Capture
items.body: Keep copied text snippets, code, URLs, and image buffers in a searchable local database rather than overwriting past history.

items.title: Collections & Cleanup
items.body: Organize essential clips into named collections, pin Favorites, and review Vault Cleanup Suggestions for duplicate groups.

items.title: Quick Paste Retrieval
items.body: Access your clip history instantly from any application using global hotkeys without losing focus in your current window.

items.title: Per-Clip Activity Ledger
items.body: Inspect timestamps and recorded actions for every clip: creation, copying, pinning, collection moves, and export package membership.

items.title: Command Center Actions
items.body: Execute Phase 1 Hotkey Actions: open the vault or Quick Paste, pause or resume capture, save the current clipboard to a Safe, run a saved Vault Macro, or lock the vault instantly.
items.note: Limited to implemented Phase 1 Hotkey Actions. Text Expansions reflect future phases.

items.title: Receipt-Backed Exports
items.body: Export selected content as a portable folder/ZIP with a readable index (index.html), machine-readable manifest (manifest.json), and stamped receipt (stamped_receipt.txt).

items.title: Android Companion
items.body: Pair with your Android phone over local Wi-Fi via QR code to transfer text clips and URLs directly between devices without cloud servers.
items.note: Desktop {{product.versionLabel}} pairs with Android companion v{{product.companionVersion}} public baseline; v{{product.companionCandidateVersion}} (code 8) is qualified on hold.

items.title: Separate Local Profiles
items.body: Keep profile databases isolated from each other. Core desktop features stay local, and the optional companion communicates over your local network.
